title: Decorative dragon draws back

source.why_this_clip: A painted red dragon with a spiked back and curled tail is seen side-on facing left against a black ground, filling most of the frame, with small shifts of the head and claws. Cuts fall at 3.5, 4.0 and 4.25 s and a dissolve to a television starts at 7.0 s, so the interval runs from 4.25 to 6.75 s.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected16raw source samples spanning the retained interval and boundary margins in preflight-source.jpg. One continuous event; no internal cut/dissolve observed.

camera.source: similarity fit of ORB features on the still body (head masked out) against frame 10; the shift of the body centre (220,150) from frame 0.
